scope: Bind one hash-identified physical AC1018 RASTERVARIABLES frame=1 source record to a locally authored same-version wrapper, then qualify selected ASCII/Binary output, refusal/retry and typed readback. This does not qualify whole-drawing conversion or native raster behavior.

physicalWitness.provenance: ezdxf 1.4.5 authored an R2010 DXF from scratch with one LINE and RASTERVARIABLES frame=1, quality=1, units=m. ODA File Converter 27.1 converted it to AC1018 DWG and returned DXF without an .err file; the observed conversion lineage is not authenticated by hashes alone. No sample fixture was added to the repository.
physicalWitness.independentPeer: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 reports custom type 512, handle 0x2F, 18-byte body, RL boundary 111, class/frame/quality/units 0/1/1/3, role-4 owner and reactor to physical NOD 0x0A, one zero pad bit and object CRC 0x9E79. ezdxf observes frame/quality/units 1/1/3 in both input and returned DXF.
physicalWitness.sourceSpan: The source-specific callback probe confirms the 10-bit canonical frame BS spans [81,91), following quality/units fields end at the verified RL boundary bit 111, owner role-4 handle to 0x0A spans [111,127), reactor role-4 handle to 0x0A spans [127,143), and bit 143 is zero padding. Its page extraction and CRC path uses libdxfrw; that portion is not independent of this repository's reader.

implementation: The physical AC1018 frame=1 selector verifies the retained R2004 object frame and exact scalar, string-boundary, owner/reactor and NOD spans. Captured values seed a locally authored AC1018 wrapper, with source NOD 0x0A owner/reactor roles remapped to wrapper NOD 0x0C. The selector exercises selected ASCII/Binary output and the existing mutation/refusal/retry/readback controls. Physical AC1018 NOD handle 0x0A and units=3 are admitted by the source-profile checks.

validation.results: The physical AC1018 frame=1 selector passed; all six focused AC1018/AC1024/AC1032 generated CTests passed. The selected wrapper exercises ASCII/Binary invalid-value and graph-reference refusal with destination preservation, same-adapter correction/retry, and typed readback. The physical source hash was unchanged after execution.

limits: The source was locally authored and converted by one ODA version; this is not broad producer coverage.
The physical source has an unrelated HEADER integrity observation. Whole-file strict export remains unqualified and was not tested through the wrapper.
No native image rendering or downstream application behavior is established.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added; the witness remains in scratch storage.
